package.name: blueboat_perception
package.description: Perception for the BlueBoat side-scan survey: takes the GCS seabed images and their metadata, runs preprocessing (identity), a detector (a dummy today, YOLO later) and a calibration hook (identity), and publishes detections for the station map plus one record per image for the future Belief module. Also has a dataset-creation mode and an offline CLI over recorded sessions. The core is ROS-free and deterministic.
